subject: RETRY phrase
notes: kb/Work PB1163 landed (w73b). cite.py --check 14.7.9.3 "If the FOREVER phrase is specified, the mass storage control system shall attempt to gain access to a locked resource until the input-output operation has been completed" -> OK 3). Every attempt now names its holder (RetryAttempt.HolderOutsideRunUnit): Table 19's '61', OpenByAnotherConnector's '62' and every record lock are held INSIDE the run unit; FileConnector.Open's host-refusal '61' and HostFile.IsHeldByAnother's '62' are held OUTSIDE it. RetryLoop's FOREVER arm re-attempts every FileRegistry.RetryInterval (100 ms) while the holder is outside, until the operation completes; against an inside holder, which cannot release while the statement executes, it re-checks once and stops (the A.1 item 109 deadlock for a record, the conflict's own status for a file). Probe on the w73b build: DELETE FILE F RETRY FOREVER and OPEN INPUT RETRY FOREVER G, each held FileShare.None by another process for ~3 s: before DELFOREVER=62 / OPENFOREVER=61 after 68 ms with the file present; after 00 / 00, file deleted.
